item.title: How big should the spoon be?
item.dc:creator: Batesthommie
item.description: A correctly drawn five hundred beats a biased forty thousand. In a simulated country where the true result is fixed before anyone is interviewed, 500 interviews drawn from the whole register name the winner in 99.2% of runs and 40,000 drawn only from phone owners name it in none of them. Nasir El-Rufai dismissed Nigeria’s 2023 polls for the wrong reason, and had the right one in his next sentence.
